definitions.gloss: beam, ray of light, light ray
definitions.explanation: A line or stream of light, especially one coming from a particular source.

examples.japanese: {紫外|しがい}{光線|こうせん}は{肌|はだ}に{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: Ultraviolet rays are bad for the skin.

examples.japanese: {太陽|たいよう}の{光線|こうせん}が{部屋|へや}に{差|さ}し{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: Rays of sunlight streamed into the room.

examples.japanese: レーザー{光線|こうせん}を{使|つか}った{手術|しゅじゅつ}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: Surgery using laser beams was performed.

notes:
{光線|こうせん} refers to rays or beams of light, often used in scientific or technical contexts.

COMMON TYPES:
- {太陽|たいよう}{光線|こうせん}: sunlight, solar rays
- {紫外|しがい}{光線|こうせん}: ultraviolet rays (UV)
- {赤外|せきがい}{光線|こうせん}: infrared rays
- レーザー{光線|こうせん}: laser beam
- X{線|せん}: X-rays

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {光線|こうせん}を{浴|あ}びる: to be exposed to rays
- {光線|こうせん}が{差|さ}し{込|こ}む: rays stream in
- {光線|こうせん}を{遮|さえぎ}る: to block rays

RELATED:
- {光|ひかり}: light (general term)
- {日光|にっこう}: sunlight
- {放射線|ほうしゃせん}: radiation
